_readme: HOW TO ADD YOUR REAL CLIPS TO THE HOMEPAGE CAROUSEL. The carousel at src/app/components/ShowcaseCarousel.tsx fetches THIS file at runtime. Schema: { clips: [ { src, poster, title, duration } ] }. - src: string | null — relative path from the site root, e.g. "/showcase/clips/episode-04-hook.mp4" (put the file in public/showcase/clips/). Set to null to keep a generated-poster placeholder slot. - poster: string | null — optional poster frame path, e.g. "/showcase/posters/episode-04-hook.jpg" (put the image in public/showcase/posters/). Omit it and the carousel generates layered gradient art as the poster instead. - title: string — shown overlaid on the card. - duration: string — shown overlaid on the card, e.g. "0:42". Optional extras per entry: "style" (caption-style label shown on generated posters) and "hue" ("mint" | "marigold" | "emerald" | "slate"). Tips: keep files small (H.264/AAC, ~10-15s clips render fine); the video autoplays muted on hover/enter-viewport; a missing file simply falls back to the generated poster, so nothing ever looks broken.
